title: Functional dissection of the conserved C. elegans LEM-3/ANKLE1 nuclease reveals a crucial requirement for the LEM-like and GIY-YIG domains for DNA bridge processing.
authors: Song, Junfang; Geary, Peter; Salemova, Khadisha; Rouse, John; Hong, Ye; Rolland, Stephane G M; Gartner, Anton
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold建模和生化实验解析LEM-3核酸酶对DNA桥/Holliday junction的切割机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且含结构建模，但非TF-DNA体系且方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Faithful chromosome segregation requires the removal of all DNA bridges physically linking chromatids before the completion of cell division. While several redundant safeguard mechanisms to process these DNA bridges exist from S-phase to late anaphase, the conserved LEM-3/ANKLE1 nuclease has been proposed to be part of a 'last chance' mechanism that acts at the midbody to eliminate DNA bridges that persist until late cytokinesis. We show that LEM-3 can cleave a wide range of branched DNA substrates, including flaps, forks, nicked, and intact Holliday junctions. AlphaFold modelling data suggest that the catalytic mechanism of LEM-3/ANKLE1 is conserved, mirroring the mechanism observed in bacterial GIY-YIG nucleases. We present evidence that LEM-3 may form a homodimeric complex on the Holliday junction DNA. LEM-3 LEM-like and GIY-YIG nuclease domains are essential for LEM-3 recruitment to the midbody and its nuclease activity, while its LEM-like domain is sufficient for DNA binding. Finally, we show that preventing LEM-3 nuclear access is important to avoid toxicity, likely caused by branched DNAs cleavage during normal DNA metabolism. Our data suggest that Caenorhabditis elegans LEM-3 acts as a 'last chance catch-all' enzyme that processes DNA bridges caused by various perturbations of DNA metabolism just before cells divide.
abstract_zh: 染色体忠实分离要求在细胞分裂完成前移除所有物理连接染色单体的DNA桥。尽管从S期到晚后期存在多种冗余的保障机制来处理这些DNA桥，保守的LEM-3/ANKLE1核酸酶已被提出作为“最后机会”机制的一部分，在中间体（midbody）处消除持续至胞质分裂晚期的DNA桥。我们显示LEM-3能够切割多种分支DNA底物，包括flap、分叉、切口及完整的Holliday连接体。AlphaFold建模数据表明LEM-3/ANKLE1的催化机制是保守的，镜像了细菌GIY-YIG核酸酶中观察到的机制。我们提供证据表明LEM-3可能在Holliday连接体DNA上形成同源二聚体复合物。LEM-3的LEM样结构域和GIY-YIG核酸酶结构域对于LEM-3招募至中间体及其核酸酶活性至关重要，而其LEM样结构域足以进行DNA结合。最后，我们显示阻止LEM-3进入细胞核对于避免毒性很重要，这种毒性可能由正常DNA代谢过程中分支DNA的切割引起。我们的数据表明，秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）LEM-3作为“最后机会全能捕获”酶，在细胞即将分裂前处理由各种DNA代谢扰动引起的DNA桥。
